label: The Supply Run
summary: Food at Juniper Heights runs out in four days. You lead a run to the hospital across town, through streets full of the turned.
title: The Supply Run
description: The roof garden failed in the frost. There are four days of food left for sixty people and the nearest unlooted supplies are in St. Brigid's Hospital, two miles across a dead suburb. The council has picked you to lead the run, with a team of three and one working truck.

chapterOutlines.title: The Briefing
chapterOutlines.outline: Plan the run with the team in the school library.

chapterOutlines.title: Two Miles
chapterOutlines.outline: Cross the suburb quietly, or not.

chapterOutlines.title: St. Brigid's
chapterOutlines.outline: Search the hospital, where another group got there first.

chapterOutlines.title: The Way Back
chapterOutlines.outline: Get home with the supplies, and with everyone.

scene.location: The library of Juniper Heights High, turned into a map room, at dawn on Day 41
scene.summary: A map of the town is taped across the tables, red Xs everywhere. Your team is waiting. The kitchen staff are pretending not to listen.

openThreads: Who else is at the hospital?
Someone on the team is hiding a bite. Who?

npcs.name: Coach Dana Briggs
npcs.role: Former gym teacher, head of security
npcs.description: The school's former gym teacher, now its head of security. She runs the fortress like a championship season.

npcs.name: Marcus Bell
npcs.description: A night-shift nurse who walked into the school with a bag of medicine on Day 2 and has been holding everyone together since.
goals: Find insulin for a sick survivor

npcs.name: Lena Ortiz
npcs.description: A former delivery driver who knows every back road in town and treats the turned like bad traffic.
goals: Get to her sister's house near the hospital

relationships.label: Teammate
relationships.status: Thinks the plan is too careful

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: Quiet, reliable, opens doors and solves problems.

items.name: Walkie-talkie
items.description: Reaches the school from about a mile away. The battery is at half.
